project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite educational platform (RTL Arabic)
build_system: Vite 5.4, npm workspaces (monorepo with frontend/ and backend/)
test_framework: No test runner configured in frontend - verification is TypeScript compilation
verification_instructions: Run `npx tsc -b --noEmit` in frontend/ to verify no TS errors. The project has strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess enabled.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - code is already present. Cannot install packages (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network).
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install, no external packages. All animations must be CSS-only. No Lottie, GSAP, framer-motion. Use Web Audio API for sound. TypeScript strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Must not break existing functionality.
contribution_requirements: All code must pass tsc strict. RTL-first design. Use existing CSS custom properties from tokens.css. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. No new npm dependencies.
key_patterns: CSS layers loaded in order in main.tsx (tokens -> base -> components -> redesign -> world-class). Zustand stores with persist middleware. useReveal hook for scroll animations. Icon component wraps lucide-react. Card/Badge primitives in src/components/primitives/. Illustration components are inline SVG with CSS animation classes.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - all CSS files loaded in order. frontend/src/components/ - reusable UI. frontend/src/pages/ - route pages. frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand state. frontend/src/hooks/ - custom hooks.
